name: Delia Fine
bio: Mrs. Fine was a 16 year Emmy Award winning television producer with The Arts & Entertainment Network. Credits include: Pride and Prejudice, Horatio Hornblower, Shackleton, Murder in a Small Town and Longitude. Before joining A & E, Mrs. Fine was Senior Producer of the Investigative News Group, The Tribune Company, ABC Television and CNN. She produced Geraldo Rivera's syndicated news-talk show, "Geraldo." She also launched Regis Philbin in the New York market on WABC's "The Morning Show." She was born on September 5, 1951 to Elizabeth and Wilbur Hattendorf in Evanston, IL. She was educated at Northwestern University School of Speech, Evanston, IL. Delia is survived by her husband of 38 years, B.
